name: Mambrilla de Castrejón (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a blue wavy stripe across the centre, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Mambrilla de Castrejón (stars and a castle on blue and red).
history: Municipal flag of Mambrilla de Castrejón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Mambrilla de Castrejón arms — stars and castle
